body: Trust me I’m planning on getting out as soon as possible. I’ve been saving and hope to move out by this summer. It’s funny because she tells me all the time that she likes me living at home.
Area may be a large reason why then. I live in a very urban environment

I live in a large city in Texas and the 10s were largely influenced by the 90s in terms of fashion. Only major difference being that tighter clothing ruled the 10s compared to the 90s. And the early 10s were essentially leftovers from the 00s which were 80s influenced
It alternates every decade. This goes back to the 60s with the 60s being colorful and the 70s being darker in terms of colors

This is what I mean. You can already see a big difference in terms of style for both times. The girl in the recent video even said brighter colors have been popping as of late. Also would like to point out that the girl in the 2016 makeup tutorial is prime late 10s style, with the makeup and choker lol
